scope: SEC-07/18 scalar IPC attachment submission. Move/copy sends and move/copy/read/write-loan calls retain both exact roots and prepare memory outside IPC; single sends retain a complete inert parent and explicitly finish ordinary outcomes after the local IPC guard. Public ABI and hidden-delivery rules are unchanged.
source_review: The baseline scalar move-send path prepares memory, allocates attachment storage and destroys PreparedTransfer under IPC. Move/read-loan/write-loan calls likewise prepare under IPC. Existing copy/vector submission already captures both roots and prepares outside IPC; the correction shares that admission and revalidation contract. This is source-confirmed locking/allocation exposure, not an induced production deadlock or allocator-exhaustion result.
native_controls: Copy/move/read-loan/write-loan calls prepare real 35-page transfers outside IPC/lifecycle/root/memory/frame guards with both exact roots leased; endpoint closure then rejects publication, restores source write access and baseline budget/frame counts, and leaves no destination capability.

Copy/move sends cover attachment-storage rejection, endpoint closure, target-authority retirement and successful publication. Preparation/storage callbacks run outside local guards; publication runs beneath the actual held kernel heap guard. Rejection restores source and exact original accounting; success delivers the original byte and releases receiver capability.

An unguarded copied-send abandonment retains 70 pages/two objects instead of releasing the private 35-page copy. A moved-send abandonment runs beneath actual lifecycle/root/IPC/heap/physical/memory/authority guards. Both preserve budget, frames, authority-node usage, IRQ state and both leased roots.

Existing native IPC tests additionally cover successful calls, loan revocation, hidden delivery, cancellation and returned memory. The added scalar-call discriminator specifically tests endpoint rejection after preparation.
retention_limit: Each suite deliberately abandons one copy send and one move send: four private fixture roots remain leased, 105 original/private-copy pages remain charged, and the complete operation metadata/escrow is retained. No receipt is reconstructed for cleanup or retry. These are serialized boot fixtures, not concurrent pressure qualification.

failed_controls.classification: Fixture defect before the intended unsafe-Drop discriminator: the test queried endpoint status through a capability it had deliberately closed. Corrected assertion reads the captured internal endpoint queue. This run does not demonstrate the intended abandonment regression. Original intermediate test-source snapshot was not retained; kernel/diff/serial identities and exact diagnostic are preserved here.
